# linux_hostname (Resource)

Sets the host name, now and after reboots, with `hostnamectl` when available and `/etc/hostname` otherwise. `/etc/hosts` is not changed. Destroying the resource leaves the host name as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linux_hostname" "this" {
  name = "web-1.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Host name, such as `web-1` or `web-1.example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `hostname`.
